question: Tell me about hostel facilities.
keywords: hostel room rooms mess accommodation stay warden
answer: Hostel: On-campus hostels have AC rooms with Wi-Fi. Approx. yearly fee: Rs 2,25,000 for twin sharing and Rs 1,70,000 for triple sharing. Mess charges are usually separate. Apply for hostel separately from admission, and confirm current fees with the hostel office.

question: What sports facilities are available?
keywords: sport sports gym swimming pool tennis football cricket volleyball basketball badminton squash games playground
answer: Sports: The campus has a sports complex with 16+ facilities, including a swimming pool, tennis courts, football ground, cricket field, volleyball court, and air-conditioned indoor basketball, badminton and squash courts, plus gyms. Day scholars pay a sports charge of about Rs 26,000 per year.

question: What clubs and events are there?
keywords: club clubs society societies event events fest activities extracurricular cultural startup startups fests festival
answer: Clubs and events: The university has 40+ student-led clubs and societies, and events and activities run throughout the year. Follow the official Bennett University pages and student notices for upcoming events.

question: Is university transport available?
keywords: transport bus buses commute metro pickup dayscholar scholar
answer: Transport: The university provides transportation facilities for day scholars. Ask the transport office or check the student portal for routes and charges.

question: What medical facilities are on campus?
keywords: medical doctor hospital health wellness emergency sick clinic
answer: Medical: The campus has a wellness center and medical support. The university has tie-ups with Kailash Hospital and Yatharth Hospital in Greater Noida.

question: How is attendance tracked?
keywords: attendance biometric collpoll present absent shortage
answer: Attendance: Attendance is taken digitally through biometrics and updated on the CollPoll system, so students and parents can track it.

question: What food options are available on campus?
keywords: cafe restaurant snacks tuckshop foodcourt street lunch dinner breakfast veg food foods cafeteria canteen eat
answer: Food: The campus has a multi-cuisine cafeteria, food courts, a street food truck and a tuck shop. Hostel students get mess facilities (charged separately).

question: What is the eligibility for postgraduate programs?
keywords: mba mca mtech ma pg postgraduate masters phd doctoral bumat cat xat mat cmat
answer: Postgraduate eligibility: MBA needs a graduation degree (accepted exams include CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT or the university's own BUMAT). MCA needs graduation in any discipline with 50% aggregate. M.Tech needs 50% in B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc. M.A. needs 50% in graduation plus a personal interview. PhD programs are also available.

question: What other UG programs are offered?
keywords: bdes design budat law llb bba bca bsc liberal journalism media
answer: Other UG programs: B.Des needs Class 12 with 50% (entrance exam is BUDAT). Programs also include BBA, BCA, B.Sc, BA (Film, TV & Web Series, Mass Communication, Liberal Arts) and BA LLB (Hons). Check bennett.edu.in for each program's exact eligibility.

question: Are there international exchange or global programs?
keywords: global abroad international exchange iowa essex ottawa foreign pathway mou
answer: Global programs: The B.Tech Global (CSE) pathway offers 2 years at Bennett and 2 years at Iowa State University (USA), or time at the University of Essex (UK). Bennett also signed an MoU with the University of Ottawa, Canada, in 2026.

question: Which entrance exams are accepted?
keywords: jee cuet sat gmat nmat exam entrance accepted test
answer: Entrance exams: B.Tech accepts JEE Main (the university also considers Class 12 marks). Other accepted exams include CUET, SAT, CAT, XAT, NMAT, MAT, CMAT and GMAT for management, plus the university's own BUMAT (MBA) and BUDAT (B.Des).

question: When does the academic session start?
keywords: session start commencement begin july august semester orientation classes
answer: Session: The academic session usually begins in July to August. Orientation and class start dates are announced by the university after admission.

question: What documents are required for admission?
keywords: document documents marksheet certificate required papers checklist photo marksheets certificates
answer: Documents: Keep your Class 10 and 12 marksheets, entrance exam scorecard (if any), ID proof and passport-size photos ready. The exact checklist is given in your application on bennett.edu.in.

question: What facilities are available on campus?
keywords: facility facilities library labs lab wifi wi-fi auditorium cafeteria canteen atm campus infrastructure acres classroom classrooms
answer: Facilities: The campus is spread over about 68 acres, with smart classrooms, labs, a central library (plus a dedicated law library), auditorium, cafeteria and food court, tuck shop, ATM, Wi-Fi and separate hostels for boys and girls. The campus is also plastic free.

question: What are the university highlights and rankings?
keywords: highlight highlights ranking rank recognition approved ugc aicte collaboration collaborations
answer: Highlights: Bennett University is UGC-recognised and NAAC A+ graded, with 50+ programs, 20+ corporate collaborations and 40+ student clubs. It was founded in 2016 by The Times of India Group.

question: What is the admission process?
keywords: admission admissions apply application eligibility join entrance jee criteria
answer: Admissions: Admissions run on a rolling, first-come first-served basis in rounds. B.Tech eligibility: 55% in Class 12 with Physics, Maths and one more subject (CSE, ECE, ME, EP); 65% for AI. JEE Main is accepted. Hostel is applied for separately. Apply on bennett.edu.in and check the website for the current round and deadline.

question: What courses are available?
keywords: course courses btech program programs branch subjects syllabus bca mba bba specialization
answer: Courses: B.Tech (CSE, ECE, Mechanical, Engineering Physics, AI, Biotechnology), integrated B.Tech + M.Tech, BCA, BCA + MCA, B.Sc, BA, B.Des, BBA, BA LLB (Hons), MBA, M.Tech and PhD. There are also Global B.Tech pathways with partner universities abroad such as Iowa State University and the University of Essex.

question: Where can I get scholarship information?
keywords: scholarship scholarships merit financial aid waiver discount loan
answer: Scholarships: The university offers merit-based scholarships. Early application gives an advantage for scholarship eligibility. See the scholarships page under Admissions on bennett.edu.in for current criteria.

question: Where can I check my fee details?
keywords: fee fees tuition payment pay cost installment registration charges
answer: Fees: B.Tech tuition is roughly Rs 3.5 lakh per year (approximate, varies by programme), with a registration fee of about Rs 45,000. Day scholars pay a sports charge of Rs 26,000 per year, and there is a one-time alumni charge of Rs 1,500. Fees can change, so confirm the latest amount on the student portal or bennett.edu.in.

question: What career support and placements are available?
keywords: placement placements internship internships job jobs recruitment company companies package salary recruiters
answer: Placements: Over 1200 companies have visited campus. Reported B.Tech figures: highest package about Rs 1.37 crore per annum, average about Rs 11.10 LPA. Recruiters include Meta, Microsoft, Adani, Deloitte, Reliance, Infosys and American Express. Type 'career' for resume tips.
